description.value: Wentworth Villa is a Carpenter Gothic heritage house built in 1863 and attributed to local architects Wright and Sanders, operated as an architectural heritage museum by the Pacific Northwest Heritage Homes Foundation. Its exhibitions explore Victoria's residential architectural history through artifacts, historic photography, and the stories of the architects and families who shaped the city. The museum won the Heritage BC Conservation Award in 2016 and also hosts guided historic walking tours of Fort Street.
